games.name: Pordier at War
games.desc:
Pordier at War is a first-person shooter inspired by the First World War and works of high fantasy. Every match is set in a unique, procedurally generated landscape where players work to push the front for advances that can be measured in meters. Utilizing building and trench digging mechanics, players exploit the terrain and adapt with an ever-changing destructible environment.

This experience contains flashing lights and may be unfit for photosensitive users.

games.name: [BETA] Classic Nations
games.desc:
JOIN OUR GROUP AND LIKE THE GAME FOR A WEALTH BOOSTER WHEN STARTING A NEW COUNTRY:
https://www.roblox.com/groups/15018646/LinQ-Studios

Welcome to Classic Nations, a real-time strategy and roleplay experience, by LinQ Studios. It is inspired by an old game series called Nations. Not only does this game feature similar gameplay, it also goes deeper into both aspects of strategy and roleplay.

Your goal is to become the number one superpower in the server. Once you start a country, you can manage its resources, expand territories, participate in wars, trade with others, and more. It is up to you how much you dedicate to strategy and how much to roleplay!

We would like to strongly encourage you to check out our social links, especially the communications server, where players can engage in fun events, receive sneak-peaks and change logs, and easily communicate with moderators and developers!

NOTE: If you suddenly rejoin the game, it is likely due to a new update or a server restart.
